pasos: Beat the eggs with the milk, cinnamon, and sugar.
Soak each slice of bread for 30 seconds per side.
Brown in butter for 2-3 minutes per side.
Serve with honey and fresh fruit.
1.tip: Use day-old bread: it absorbs the mixture better and stays creamy inside without falling apart.

2.nombre: Oatmeal Bowl with Fruit and Peanut Butter
pasos: Cook the oats with the plant-based milk for 5 minutes.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with banana, peanut butter, and berries.
Sprinkle with cinnamon.
2.tip: Soak the oats overnight: they turn creamy without any cooking needed.

pasos: Slice the potatoes thin and fry gently for 10 minutes.
Add onion and spinach, cook 3 more minutes.
Beat the eggs with salt and mix with the potatoes.
Cook 5 minutes per side.
3.tip: Flip the tortilla using a plate, not a spatula: it will stay whole and even.

pasos: Mash the banana.
Mix with plant-based milk and oil.
Add flour, baking powder, and cinnamon.
Cook portions for 2 minutes per side.
4.tip: Wait for bubbles to appear on the surface before flipping: that way they won't break.

pasos: Sauté onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add tomato, cumin, and paprika, cook 10 minutes.
Make wells and crack the eggs in.
Cover and cook 5-6 minutes until set.
5.tip: If the sauce is too watery, uncover for the last few minutes to reduce it before adding the eggs.

pasos: Boil water with a splash of vinegar.
Create a whirlpool and drop in the egg, cook 3 minutes.
Toast the bread and mash the avocado with lime and salt.
Top with the egg and chili flakes.
6.tip: The water whirlpool before dropping the egg is the secret to a compact poached egg.

pasos: Blend the mango, banana, and plant-based milk.
Pour into a bowl.
Top with chia, granola, and coconut.
7.tip: Freeze the fruit beforehand: it gives an ice cream-like texture without needing ice.

8.nombre: Homemade Granola with Yogurt and Berries
pasos: Mix oats, almonds, honey, oil, and cinnamon.
Spread on a baking sheet and bake 20 minutes at 320°F (160°C), stirring halfway.
Let cool completely without touching until crunchy.
Serve over yogurt with berries.
8.tip: Let the granola cool completely without touching it: that's when the crunchy clusters form.

pasos: Crumble the tofu with a fork.
Sauté with turmeric and pepper for 6 minutes until golden.
Heat the beans and tortillas.
Assemble the burrito with tofu, beans, avocado, and hot sauce.
9.tip: Turmeric gives the tofu that scrambled-egg yellow color and a subtle flavor boost.

pasos: Roast the chickpeas with cumin and paprika for 20 minutes at 400°F (200°C).
Cook the quinoa separately.
Assemble the bowl with quinoa, raw vegetables, and chickpeas.
Dress with tahini thinned with water and lemon.
10.tip: Pat the chickpeas dry with a towel before roasting: they'll turn crunchy instead of rubbery.

pasos: Cook the pasta.
Blend spinach, walnuts, garlic, and cream into a sauce.
Toss with the hot pasta and a splash of cooking water.
Serve with Parmesan.
11.tip: Save a cup of pasta water before draining: it helps the sauce come together without getting heavy.

pasos: Marinate the cauliflower with achiote, spices, and pineapple juice for 10 minutes.
Roast or sauté until golden, about 20 minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Assemble tacos with cauliflower, pineapple, onion, and cilantro.
12.tip: Don't skip the pineapple in the marinade: the acid helps the cauliflower absorb more flavor.

pasos: Sauté the mushrooms separately and set aside.
Sweat the onion, add the rice, and toast for 2 minutes.
Add the wine and let it evaporate.
Add the hot broth a ladle at a time for 18-20 minutes.
Stir in the mushrooms, butter, and Parmesan.
13.tip: Always add the broth hot: cold broth stops the rice from cooking and leaves it hard.

14.nombre: Warm Quinoa and Roasted Vegetable Salad
pasos: Roast the diced vegetables with oil and salt for 25 minutes.
Cook the quinoa separately.
Toss everything together while warm with balsamic vinegar and herbs.
14.tip: Cut the vegetables to the same size so they roast evenly — no raw or burnt pieces.

pasos: Slice the eggplant into rounds, salt, and let rest 10 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry 3 minutes per side.
Build the sandwich with goat cheese, arugula, and eggplant.
Finish with a drizzle of honey.
15.tip: Salting the eggplant before cooking keeps it from absorbing too much oil and reduces bitterness.

pasos: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger for 3 minutes.
Add the curry powder and toast for 1 minute.
Add chickpeas and coconut milk, cook 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach at the end.
Serve with rice.
16.tip: Toast the curry powder in the oil before adding liquids: it intensifies the flavor enormously.

pasos: Sauté onion and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add lentils, potato, cumin, and bay leaf.
Cover with broth and cook 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and serve.
17.tip: Dry-toast the cumin for one minute before adding it: it releases much more aroma than adding it directly.

pasos: Spread a generous layer of hummus on the tortilla.
Add carrot, cucumber, spinach, and sprouts.
Roll tightly and cut in half.
18.tip: Place the wetter vegetables like cucumber in the center and away from the edges so the wrap doesn't tear.

pasos: Grill the zucchini and eggplant in slices.
Prepare the béchamel.
Layer alternating pasta, vegetables, tomato sauce, and béchamel.
Top with mozzarella and bake 35 minutes at 375°F (190°C).
19.tip: Let the lasagna rest 10 minutes out of the oven before cutting: it holds together instead of falling apart.

pasos: Soak the noodles in hot water.
Sauté the cubed tofu until golden.
Add carrot and bean sprouts.
Add the noodles and sauce, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Serve with peanuts and scallions.
20.tip: Don't overcook the noodles in water: they finish cooking in the pan, and overdoing it makes them sticky.

pasos: Cut the tops off the peppers and hollow them out.
Mix the rice with tomato sauce, sautéed onion, corn, and half the cheese.
Stuff the peppers.
Top with remaining cheese and bake 30 minutes at 375°F (190°C).
21.tip: Bake the peppers standing up in a dish with a little water at the bottom: they cook evenly without drying out.

pasos: Sauté onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the spices and toast 1 minute.
Add beans, corn, and tomato sauce.
Cook on medium heat 20 minutes until thickened.
22.tip: The longer you let it simmer on low heat, the more the flavors concentrate: give it 40 minutes if you have time.

pasos: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature possible.
Stretch the dough and spread with tomato sauce.
Add mozzarella and vegetables.
Bake 12-15 minutes until golden.
Finish with fresh basil.
23.tip: Preheat the baking sheet too: the dough hits a hot surface and turns out crispy.

pasos: Slice the eggplant and coat in flour, egg, and breadcrumbs.
Fry or bake until golden.
Layer with tomato sauce, eggplant, and cheeses.
Bake 25 minutes at 375°F (190°C) until bubbly.
24.tip: Bake the slices instead of frying for a lighter version with almost the same delicious result.

pasos: Dissolve the miso in a little warm broth — don't boil it.
Heat the rest of the broth and stir in the dissolved miso.
Sauté the tofu and mushrooms separately.
Cook the noodles.
Assemble the bowl with everything.
25.tip: Never boil the miso directly: high heat kills its flavor. Always dissolve it in warm broth.

pasos: Sauté the tofu until golden and set aside.
Fry the curry paste for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and bring to medium heat.
Add the vegetables and cook 10 minutes.
Add the tofu and a splash of soy sauce; serve with rice.
26.tip: Fry the curry paste before adding liquid: it wakes up all its aroma.

pasos: Mash the beans, leaving some texture.
Mix with oats, egg, cumin, and garlic powder.
Shape into patties and refrigerate 15 minutes.
Cook 4 minutes per side.
Assemble with bun, cheese, and vegetables.
27.tip: Refrigerate the patties before cooking: they firm up and are much less likely to fall apart.

pasos: Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon, and oil until creamy.
Add cold water gradually if it's too thick.
Serve with carrot and celery sticks.
28.tip: Peel the chickpeas before blending (even though it's extra work): the hummus turns out much silkier.

pasos: Process the dates into a paste.
Mix with oats, cocoa, peanut butter, and salt.
Roll into balls with your hands.
Refrigerate 20 minutes before eating.
29.tip: If the dates are too dry, soak them in warm water for 10 minutes before processing.

pasos: Heat the oil in a pot with a lid.
Add the corn, cover, and shake occasionally.
Remove when the popping sounds slow down.
Toss with paprika, garlic powder, nutritional yeast, and salt.
30.tip: Nutritional yeast gives it a cheesy flavor without dairy: the secret to the best vegan popcorn.

pasos: Remove the tough stems and tear into pieces.
Toss with oil, salt, and paprika by hand.
Spread on a baking sheet without crowding.
Bake 12-15 minutes at 300°F (150°C) until crispy.
31.tip: Bake at low temperature and watch the last few minutes: kale goes from crispy to burnt very quickly.

pasos: Mash the avocados, leaving some texture.
Add onion, tomato, cilantro, and lime.
Season with salt.
Serve immediately with chips.
32.tip: Leave an avocado pit in the guacamole and cover well: it takes longer to oxidize.

pasos: Process the dates into a sticky paste.
Mix with half the coconut, oil, and vanilla.
Roll into balls.
Roll in the remaining shredded coconut.
33.tip: Wet your hands before rolling: the sticky mixture won't stick to your fingers.

pasos: Boil salted water.
Cook the edamame for 4-5 minutes.
Drain and cool briefly under cold water.
Sprinkle with sea salt and chili to taste.
34.tip: Serve the edamame while still warm: the salt sticks better to the moist pods than when cold.

pasos: Toss the nuts with oil, cumin, paprika, and salt.
Spread on a baking sheet.
Bake 10-12 minutes at 340°F (170°C), stirring halfway.
Let cool before storing.
35.tip: Let them cool completely before putting them in a jar: storing them warm creates steam that softens them.

pasos: Place all ingredients in the blender.
Blend until completely smooth.
Serve cold immediately.
36.tip: Freeze the banana in slices ahead of time: besides chilling the smoothie, it makes it creamier.

pasos: Mix dry ingredients on one side and wet on another.
Combine both without overmixing.
Cook in a hot waffle iron 4-5 minutes until golden.
Serve with berries and syrup.
37.tip: Don't overmix the batter: a few lumps are fine — overmixing makes waffles tough instead of fluffy.

38.nombre: Green Shakshuka with Kale and Feta
pasos: Blend cilantro with a bit of broth or water into a sauce.
Sauté onion, chili, and kale for 5 minutes.
Add the green sauce and cumin, cook 5 more minutes.
Crack the eggs on top, cover, and cook 5-6 minutes.
Finish with crumbled feta.
38.tip: If the kale releases too much water, raise the heat for the last few minutes so the sauce doesn't get watery.

pasos: Blend the oats, milk, banana, and vanilla into a thin batter.
Let rest 5 minutes.
Cook thin portions in a greased pan, 1-2 minutes per side.
Fill or top with fruit and cinnamon.
39.tip: Use a ladle and swirl the pan as soon as you pour the batter: the crepes come out thin and even.

pasos: Marinate cubed tofu in soy sauce and sesame oil for 15 minutes.
Cook the sushi rice and let it cool slightly.
Sear the marinated tofu in a hot pan for 3 minutes.
Build the bowl with rice, tofu, edamame, cucumber, and carrot.
Top with nori and sesame seeds.
40.tip: Let the rice cool to room temperature before assembling: hot rice overcooks the other ingredients.

pasos: Process the chickpeas with garlic, herbs, cumin, and flour into a thick dough.
Shape into small balls or ovals.
Bake 20-25 minutes at 400°F (200°C), flipping halfway.
Make the tahini sauce with lemon and water.
Serve in pita bread with the sauce.
41.tip: Refrigerate the falafel mixture 15 minutes before shaping: they hold together much better and won't fall apart when baked.

pasos: Slice the tomatoes and mozzarella.
Blend basil, nuts, olive oil, and a pinch of salt for the pesto.
Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Drizzle with pesto and balsamic.
42.tip: Take the mozzarella out of the fridge 15 minutes before serving: its flavor and texture improve a lot at room temperature.

pasos: Roast the eggplant in slices with a little oil.
Sauté the onion, add lentils, tomato sauce, and a pinch of cinnamon, cook 10 minutes.
Prepare the béchamel.
Layer eggplant and lentil filling.
Top with béchamel and Parmesan, bake 30 minutes at 375°F (190°C).
43.tip: The pinch of cinnamon in the lentil filling is the classic Greek touch that makes the difference: don't skip it.

44.nombre: Potato Gnocchi with Tomato and Basil
pasos: Bake or boil the potatoes until very soft and mash them.
Mix the mash with egg, flour, and salt into a dough.
Roll into thin logs and cut into pieces, mark with a fork.
Boil the gnocchi until they float, 2-3 minutes.
Serve with tomato sauce, basil, and Parmesan.
44.tip: Don't overwork the potato dough: the less you knead it, the lighter the gnocchi turn out.

pasos: Line a mold with the tart shell and prick with a fork.
Blanch the asparagus 2 minutes in boiling water.
Beat the eggs with cream, salt, and pepper.
Arrange the asparagus and goat cheese pieces on the shell.
Pour the egg mixture and bake 30-35 minutes at 375°F (190°C) until set.
45.tip: Blind-bake the shell 10 minutes before adding the filling: it keeps the center from being raw.

46.nombre: Vegetarian Avocado and Cucumber Sushi Rolls
pasos: Cook the sushi rice and mix with rice vinegar, let cool.
Spread the rice on nori, leaving a free edge.
Place avocado, cucumber, carrot, and cream cheese in a line.
Roll tightly using a bamboo mat.
Slice into pieces and serve with soy sauce.
46.tip: Wet the knife before each cut: the rice won't stick and the pieces come out much cleaner.

pasos: Sauté onion and pepper for 5 minutes.
Add the half-mashed lentils, spices, and a little tomato sauce.
Cook 5 minutes until thickened and let cool.
Fill the dough rounds, close, and seal the edges.
Bake 20 minutes at 400°F (200°C) until golden.
47.tip: Mash only half the lentils: it gives the filling body without losing the texture.

pasos: Blend the drained beans with oil and vanilla into a smooth paste.
Mix with cocoa, sugar, and baking powder.
Fold in chocolate chips and pour into a baking pan.
Bake 25 minutes at 350°F (180°C).
Let cool completely before cutting.
48.tip: You can't taste the beans: the cocoa and sugar cover them completely, and they come out moist like a classic brownie.

pasos: Stir-fry the julienned vegetables with soy sauce and ginger for 4 minutes, let cool.
Fill the wrappers and roll tightly, sealing the edges with water.
Place on a baking sheet and spray lightly with oil.
Bake 18-20 minutes at 400°F (200°C), flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.
49.tip: Let the filling cool before assembling: if it's hot, the wrapper gets soggy and tears when rolling.

pasos: Freeze the sliced banana at least 2 hours ahead — that's what makes it creamy.
Wash the strawberries and remove the leaves.
Blend everything until smooth, about 60 seconds.
Taste and adjust sweetness with agave if needed. Serve right away.
50.tip: If it's too thick, add milk a splash at a time. Loosening a smoothie is much easier than thickening one.

pasos: Strain the passion fruit pulp if you'd rather skip the seeds.
Blend the pineapple with coconut water until smooth.
Add the passion fruit and lime, blend 10 seconds more.
Serve very cold with a pineapple wedge on the rim.
51.tip: Frozen pineapple stands in for ice without watering the drink down. Buy it ripe, cube it, and keep it in the freezer.

ingredientes: Berries, banana and shredded coconut to top
pasos: Let the açaí pulp sit 2 minutes at room temperature so you can break it up.
Blend açaí, frozen banana and coconut milk. Go light on the liquid — it should be thick enough for a spoon to stand up in.
If the blender stalls, push the mix down with a spatula instead of adding more milk.
Serve in a chilled bowl and top in stripes: granola, berries, sliced banana and coconut.
Finish with a drizzle of almond butter.
52.tip: Chill the bowl in the freezer for 10 minutes first. It stays creamy far longer while you top it and take photos.

pasos: Sauté the mushrooms in a hot pan without stirring much, until golden, about 5 minutes. Set aside.
Add the spinach to the same pan and sauté 1 minute, just until wilted. Set aside too.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper. Melt the butter over medium-low heat and pour the eggs in.
When the edges set but the centre is still creamy, add the filling and cheese to one half.
Fold with a spatula and serve immediately.
53.tip: Medium-low heat and patience. The classic mistake is high heat: the omelette browns outside and turns dry and rubbery inside.

pasos: Hollandaise: whisk the yolks with lemon over a gentle bain-marie, water simmering but not boiling and not touching the bowl.
Add the melted butter in a thin stream while whisking constantly, until thickened. Take off the heat and season.
Sauté the asparagus 4 minutes and the spinach 1 minute. Toast the muffins.
Poach the eggs: water just below a boil with the vinegar, swirl it, drop the egg in. 3 minutes.
Assemble: muffin, spinach, asparagus, poached egg, hollandaise over the top.
54.tip: If the hollandaise splits, pull it off the heat and whisk in a tablespoon of ice-cold water. It usually comes back together.

pasos: Pat the tofu dry with paper towel and brown it in hot oil on all sides. Set aside.
In the same very hot pan, sauté the garlic 30 seconds, then add carrot and peas.
Add the cold rice and spread it out. Leave it alone for 1 minute so it catches some colour before stirring.
Pour the soy sauce around the edges of the pan, not over the rice.
Return the tofu, finish with sesame oil and spring onion.
55.tip: Day-old rice, always. Fresh rice steams and clumps; cold rice separates into loose grains.

pasos: Boil the tomatillos with the jalapeños and onion for 10 minutes, until they turn from bright to dull green.
Blend with the cilantro and salt to make the green sauce.
Pass each tortilla through hot oil for 10 seconds a side. They turn pliable and won't crack when rolled.
Fill with zucchini, corn and some of the cheese. Roll and arrange in a baking dish.
Cover with the green sauce, add the remaining cheese and bake 15 minutes at 180 °C / 355 °F.
Serve with cream on top.
56.tip: Don't skip the oil step for the tortillas. It's the difference between whole enchiladas and a dish of torn tortillas.

pasos: Halve the tomatoes and roast them with the onion and garlic at 200 °C / 390 °F for 20 minutes, with oil and salt.
Transfer everything to a pot with the stock and cook 5 minutes.
Blend until completely smooth.
Return to the pot, add the coconut milk and chopped basil. Warm through without letting it boil.
Serve topped with the toasted bread cubes.
57.tip: Roasting the tomatoes instead of boiling them concentrates the sugar and cuts the acidity. It's the step that separates a watery soup from one with real depth.

pasos: Halve the squash and scoop out the seeds. Brush with oil, salt and pepper.
Roast cut-side down at 200 °C / 390 °F for 30 minutes, until the flesh gives when pierced.
Meanwhile, rinse the quinoa and cook it in the stock for 15 minutes. Rest covered 5 minutes.
Sauté the onion and fold it into the quinoa with the walnuts, cranberries and thyme.
Fill the squash and return to the oven for 10 more minutes.
58.tip: Rinse the quinoa before cooking, always. It has a naturally bitter coating, and those 30 seconds under water show up in the final dish.

pasos: Slice the eggplant, zucchini and tomatoes thinly and to the same thickness. That's what makes everything cook evenly.
Sauté the chopped onion, garlic and bell pepper for 8 minutes. Add the crushed tomatoes and cook 10 minutes more.
Spread that sauce over the bottom of a round baking dish.
Stand the slices upright, alternating colours in a spiral, packed tightly.
Drizzle with oil, salt, pepper and thyme. Cover with foil and bake at 190 °C / 375 °F for 40 minutes.
Uncover and bake 15 minutes more. Finish with fresh basil.
59.tip: Salt the eggplant slices and leave them on paper towel for 20 minutes before assembling. They release their bitter water instead of flooding the dish.

pasos: Warm the refried beans and spread a layer over each toasted tortilla.
Make the red salsa: blend roasted tomato, chile and onion, and cook 10 minutes until it thickens.
Fry the eggs to your liking, with a runny yolk.
Serve the tortilla with beans, the egg on top, and cover with the hot red salsa.
Finish with fresh cheese, avocado and cilantro.
60.tip: Toast the tortilla directly over the flame for a few seconds per side before assembling. It gives a smoky flavor no pan can match.

61.nombre: Chia Pudding with Berries and Nuts
pasos: Mix the chia with the almond milk and agave in a jar.
Stir well and let sit 5 minutes, then stir again so it doesn't clump.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight.
Before serving, top with the berries, granola and nuts.
61.tip: Stir the mixture twice within the first 10 minutes of chilling. That's the trick to keep the chia from clumping at the bottom of the jar.

pasos: In a jar, add a layer of granola at the bottom.
Add a layer of yogurt.
Repeat the layers alternating granola, yogurt and fruit.
Finish with fruit on top, a drizzle of honey and the sunflower seeds.
Serve right away so the granola stays crunchy.
62.tip: Assemble the parfait right before serving, not the night before. Granola sitting in yogurt for hours loses all its crunch.

pasos: Cut the tomato, cucumber, onion and pepper into large chunks and toss in a bowl.
Add the kalamata olives.
Place the whole feta block on top, without crumbling it.
Drizzle generously with olive oil, sprinkle dried oregano and salt.
Serve with warm pita bread.
63.tip: Don't cube the feta — set the whole block on top of the salad. That's how it's actually plated at any real Greek taverna.

64.nombre: Falafel Bowl with Hummus and Chickpeas
ingredientes: Sautéed chickpeas and fresh salad to serve
pasos: Blend (no water) the chickpeas soaked overnight with onion, garlic, herbs and cumin, until you get a coarse paste.
Form small balls and fry in hot oil 3-4 minutes until golden outside.
Serve over a base of hummus.
Add sautéed chickpeas and fresh salad around it.
Finish with a drizzle of olive oil and a touch of paprika.
64.tip: Use raw soaked chickpeas, not canned. Canned ones hold too much water and the balls fall apart while frying.

ingredientes: Guacamole and pico de gallo to serve
pasos: Sauté the zucchini, bell pepper and corn for 5 minutes, until tender but firm.
Spread cheese over half a tortilla, add the sautéed vegetables and more cheese on top.
Fold the tortilla in half.
Cook in a pan or griddle 2-3 minutes per side, until the cheese melts and the tortilla browns.
Cut into triangles and serve with guacamole and pico de gallo.
65.tip: Put cheese both under AND over the vegetables, not just on one side. It acts as glue so the quesadilla doesn't fall apart when you cut it.

pasos: Sauté the chopped leek in a bit of oil for 3 minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrots and turnip, and cook 5 more minutes.
Cover with the vegetable stock and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes.
Add the peas in the last 5 minutes of cooking.
Season with salt and pepper, and finish with fresh chopped parsley.
66.tip: Cut all the vegetables to the same size. That way they cook evenly and you won't end up with mushy potato while the carrot is still hard.

ingredientes: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell pepper, carrot, green beans)
pasos: Brown the tofu in hot oil until firm outside. Set aside.
In a pot, sauté the curry paste in a bit of the thick coconut cream until fragrant, 2 minutes.
Add the rest of the coconut milk and the vegetables. Cook 8 minutes.
Return the tofu, add the soy sauce and cook 3 more minutes.
Finish with fresh basil leaves and serve with jasmine rice.
67.tip: Sauté the curry paste in the thick part of the coconut milk (the layer that rises to the top of the can), not the watery part. That's what releases its full aroma before it thins into a sauce.

pasos: Soak each rice paper wrapper in warm water for 10 seconds, until softened.
Place noodles, carrot, cucumber, avocado and fresh herbs on the wrapper.
Fold the sides in and roll tightly, like a tamale.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers.
Serve with peanut sauce for dipping.
68.tip: Don't over-soak the rice paper. Exactly 10 seconds — it keeps softening a bit more while you fill it, and it tears when rolled if you leave it longer.

pasos: Mix the mashed potato with the cheese, chives, salt, pepper and nutmeg.
Shape into small cylinders with damp hands.
Dip each croquette in beaten egg, then in breadcrumbs.
Bake at 200 °C / 390 °F for 20-25 minutes, turning halfway, until evenly golden.
Serve hot with a fresh salad.
69.tip: Chill the shaped croquettes 20 minutes before baking. Cold, they hold their shape; fresh out of the fridge, they flatten out in the oven.

70.nombre: Bircher Muesli with Apple and Almonds
pasos: Mix the oats with the milk or yogurt in a jar.
Add the grated apple, honey, and stir well.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, at least 6 hours.
Before serving, top with chopped almonds, shredded coconut and fresh apple slices.
70.tip: Grate the apple right before mixing it in, don't let it sit peeled. It browns fast and discolors the whole mix.

71.nombre: Ricotta Toast with Roasted Tomatoes and Arugula
pasos: Roast the cherry tomatoes whole with olive oil at 200 °C / 390 °F for 15 minutes, until they blister a little.
Toast the bread until golden and crisp.
Spread a generous layer of ricotta over each toast.
Arrange the cucumber, roasted tomatoes and arugula on top.
Finish with olive oil, salt, pepper and chili flakes to taste.
71.tip: Roast the tomatoes whole, not halved. Blistering under heat concentrates their sweetness inside instead of losing it to the pan.

pasos: Make the dressing: mix mayonnaise, crushed garlic, lemon juice, mustard and grated parmesan.
Wash and cut the romaine lettuce into large pieces.
Toss the lettuce with the dressing until each leaf is well coated.
Add the croutons right before serving.
Finish with shaved parmesan on top.
72.tip: Add the croutons at the end, never before. Mixed into the dressing, they lose their crunch within minutes.

pasos: Blend the basil, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan and olive oil into a smooth paste.
Cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente.
Reserve a bit of the cooking water before draining.
Toss the hot pasta with the pesto, adding cooking water if needed for creaminess.
Serve with halved fresh cherry tomatoes and more parmesan.
73.tip: Never cook the pesto over heat. Direct heat darkens the basil and kills its fresh flavor — always fold it in cold with the already-cooked pasta.

pasos: Roast the drained chickpeas with cumin and paprika at 200 °C / 390 °F for 20 minutes until crispy.
Quickly sauté the kale with a little oil and garlic.
Assemble the bowl: quinoa as the base, then kale, chickpeas, avocado and fruit arranged in sections.
Sprinkle red onion and chopped pistachios.
Finish with the tahini-lemon dressing.
74.tip: Pat the chickpeas very dry with paper towel before roasting. Extra moisture is the only thing standing between you and a crispy result.

pasos: Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise and scoop out some of the center flesh, leaving a firm border.
Chop the scooped flesh and sauté it with the onion and tomato for 5 minutes.
Mix that sauté with the cooked quinoa.
Fill the eggplants with the mixture and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 200 °C / 390 °F for 25-30 minutes, until the eggplant is tender and the cheese golden.
75.tip: Salt the scooped eggplant flesh and let it sit 10 minutes before filling. It releases the natural bitterness before it ever reaches the oven.

pasos: Cut the asparagus tips and set aside; chop the rest into small pieces.
Sauté the onion in butter for 3 minutes, add the rice and toast 2 minutes, stirring.
Pour in the white wine and let it evaporate.
Add the hot stock gradually, one ladle at a time, stirring constantly, waiting for it to absorb before adding more.
Add the chopped asparagus halfway through cooking; add the tips in the last 2 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in the parmesan and one more spoon of butter. Stir vigorously for a creamy finish.
76.tip: The stock must always be hot, never cold. Adding it cold stops the rice from cooking for a moment, leaving the risotto with an uneven texture.

ingredientes: Spring onion and sesame seeds to serve
pasos: Cook the udon noodles per package instructions and drain.
Sauté the carrot, cabbage and bell pepper in very hot oil for 3-4 minutes, keeping them crisp.
Add the noodles to the pan with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Stir-fry everything together for 2 minutes, mixing well.
Serve with chopped spring onion and toasted sesame seeds on top.
77.tip: Sauté the vegetables over very high heat and briefly. That's what keeps them crisp instead of releasing water and going limp.

pasos: Bake the cubed potatoes with olive oil and salt at 220 °C / 425 °F for 30-35 minutes, until golden and crispy.
For the brava sauce: blend the tomato, garlic, sweet and hot paprika, and vinegar. Cook the mixture 10 minutes until it thickens.
Serve the hot potatoes drenched in the brava sauce.
Add a touch of vegan mayonnaise on top.
78.tip: Bake the potatoes in a single layer, not crowded. Stacked, they steam against each other and never turn crispy.

79.nombre: Vegetarian Nachos with Cheese and Jalapeños
ingredientes: Guacamole, sour cream and pico de gallo to serve
pasos: Preheat the oven to 200 °C / 390 °F.
Spread the tortilla chips on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Scatter the cheese, black beans, corn and jalapeños on top.
Bake 8-10 minutes, until the cheese is fully melted.
Serve immediately with guacamole, sour cream and pico de gallo.
79.tip: Spread the chips in a single layer, never piled up. The ones buried underneath never get covered in melted cheese.

pasos: Mix the oat flour with the baking powder.
Beat the eggs with the milk and add to the dry ingredients, mixing until smooth.
Fold in half the blueberries gently.
Cook in the hot waffle iron until golden, 4-5 minutes.
Serve with the remaining blueberries, maple syrup and almonds.
80.tip: Don't open the waffle iron before steam stops coming out the sides. That's the sign it has released itself; forcing it open early splits the waffle in half.

81.nombre: Bagel with Cream Cheese and Cucumber
pasos: Toast the halved bagels until golden.
Spread a generous layer of cream cheese on each half.
Arrange the cucumber slices on top, overlapping.
Sprinkle chopped chives, seeds and salt.
Serve right away, while the bagel is still warm.
81.tip: Pat the cucumber slices dry with paper towel before adding them. Cucumber releases water and turns the cream cheese soggy if served straight off the cutting board.

82.nombre: Waldorf Salad with Spinach and Goat Cheese
pasos: Wash and dry the spinach well.
Thinly slice the apples right before assembling the salad.
Toss the spinach with the apples in a large bowl.
Add the walnuts, goat cheese and pomegranate seeds.
Dress with olive oil and balsamic vinegar when serving.
82.tip: Squeeze a little lemon over the apple slices if you're not serving right away. They oxidize and brown within minutes in open air.

pasos: Sauté the onion and garlic for 3 minutes, add the spinach and cook until wilted. Let cool.
Mix the sautéed spinach with the feta cheese and nutmeg to taste.
Fill each dough disc with a spoonful of the mixture.
Seal the empanadas by pressing the edges with a fork.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200 °C / 390 °F for 20-25 minutes, until golden.
83.tip: Squeeze the cooked spinach well before mixing it with the cheese. Excess water is what makes the dough tear open while baking.

pasos: Cook the pasta in salted water until al dente. Drain.
Melt the butter, add the flour and cook 1 minute stirring, without letting it brown.
Pour in the milk gradually, whisking constantly, until you get a thick, lump-free sauce.
Remove from heat and add the shredded cheese, stirring until fully melted.
Toss with the hot pasta and serve right away with a dusting of paprika.
84.tip: Add the cheese off the heat, never while boiling. Direct heat makes the cheese's fat separate, leaving the sauce oily instead of creamy.

pasos: Preheat the oven to the highest temperature possible, at least 250 °C / 480 °F.
Stretch the dough thin.
Spread the tomato sauce, leaving the border clear.
Distribute the mozzarella slices over the sauce.
Bake 10-12 minutes, until the crust is golden and bubbly.
Remove from the oven, add fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil.
85.tip: Add the fresh basil after baking, never before. Oven heat wilts it and strips away all its aroma.

pasos: Sauté the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the curry paste and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the sweet potato and sauté 2 more minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and cook over medium heat for 20 minutes, until the sweet potato is tender.
Add the chickpeas in the last 5 minutes.
Serve over white rice with fresh cilantro on top.
86.tip: Cut the sweet potato into even 2 cm cubes. Any bigger, and the center stays raw while the outside already falls apart in the curry.

pasos: Slice the baguette and toast until golden.
Rub each toasted slice with a halved garlic clove.
Mix the diced tomato with salt, olive oil and a little chopped basil.
Top half the toasts with the tomato mixture, and the other half with pesto and ricotta.
Serve right away, freshly assembled.
87.tip: Assemble the bruschetta right before serving, never ahead of time. The toast turns soggy from the tomato and loses its crunch within 10 minutes.

88.nombre: Baked Potato Stuffed with Cheese and Broccoli
pasos: Bake the whole potatoes, pierced with a fork, at 200 °C / 390 °F for 45-50 minutes, until tender inside.
Steam the broccoli for 5 minutes, keeping it firm.
Cut each potato in half and scoop out a bit of the center.
Mix the scooped flesh with butter and sour cream.
Fill the potatoes with that mixture, top with broccoli and cheddar cheese.
Return to the oven 10 more minutes, until the cheese melts.
88.tip: Pierce the whole potato with a fork several times before baking. Skip it, and trapped steam can make it burst inside the oven.

pasos: Roast the cubed pumpkin with olive oil at 200 °C / 390 °F for 30 minutes, until tender and golden at the edges.
Sauté the onion and garlic for 3 minutes in a pot.
Add the roasted pumpkin and vegetable stock. Cook 10 minutes.
Blend everything until completely smooth.
Return to the pot, add the coconut milk and warm through without boiling.
Serve with toasted pumpkin seeds on top.
89.tip: Roast the pumpkin instead of boiling it. The oven concentrates its natural sweetness and gives it a much deeper flavor than boiling in water.

ingredientes: Cacao nibs and peanut butter to garnish
pasos: Mash half the banana into a puree.
Mix the oats, milk, cocoa, banana puree and agave in a jar.
Stir well until no cocoa lumps remain.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, at least 6 hours.
Serve with the remaining banana sliced, cacao nibs and a spoonful of peanut butter.
90.tip: Dissolve the cocoa powder in warm milk before mixing it with the cold oats. Straight into cold liquid, cocoa leaves lumps that never break down overnight.

pasos: Open the croissants in half, without fully separating them.
Spread a layer of pesto on both inner sides.
Fill with alternating slices of tomato and mozzarella.
Add fresh arugula on top.
Season with salt and pepper and close gently before serving.
91.tip: Use same-day croissants, never reheated ones. Reheating breaks down the flaky layer that holds the filling without falling apart.

pasos: Peel and thinly slice the potatoes and onion.
Fry the potatoes and onion in plenty of oil over medium-low heat, 20 minutes, until tender without browning.
Drain the oil well and mix the potatoes with the beaten eggs and salt.
Pour it all into a pan with a little hot oil.
Cook 4 minutes, flip the tortilla using a plate, and cook 3 more minutes on the other side.
92.tip: Cook the potatoes over low heat, almost confit-style, never high heat. That's what leaves them tender inside instead of browned and crispy, the most common mistake.

pasos: Drain the chickpeas well and pat dry with paper towel.
Cut the bell pepper, tomatoes and onion into small pieces.
Toss the chickpeas with the vegetables and lettuce in a large bowl.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, cumin and salt.
Let it sit 5 minutes before serving so the flavors come together.
93.tip: Let the dressed salad rest 5 minutes before eating. The lemon slightly softens the chickpeas and brings out far more flavor than eating it right after mixing.

pasos: Steam the cauliflower for 8 minutes, until tender but firm.
Melt the butter, add the flour and cook 1 minute.
Whisk in the milk gradually, until you get a thick sauce.
Add half the cheese and the nutmeg, stirring until melted.
Arrange the cauliflower in a baking dish, cover with the sauce and remaining cheese.
Bake at 200 °C / 390 °F for 15-20 minutes, until browned on top.
94.tip: Steam the cauliflower, never boil it. Boiled, it soaks up water and waters down the gratin sauce; steamed, it stays firm and dry.

pasos: Slice the zucchini thinly lengthwise, with a mandoline if you have one.
Lay them on paper towel with salt for 15 minutes, to release excess water.
Mix the ricotta with the egg and chopped basil.
In a baking dish, layer: tomato sauce, zucchini, ricotta, mozzarella. Repeat.
Finish with sauce and mozzarella on top.
Bake at 190 °C / 375 °F for 35-40 minutes, until bubbly and golden.
95.tip: Don't skip salting the zucchini and letting it rest. It's the only thing standing between you and a watery lasagna after baking.

pasos: Cut the kernels off the cobs, saving some whole kernels for garnish.
Sauté the onion for 3 minutes, add the corn and potato, and cook 2 more minutes.
Cover with the vegetable stock and cook 20 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Blend until creamy, leaving some texture if you prefer.
Return to the pot, add the cream and warm through without boiling.
Serve with the reserved corn kernels and fresh cilantro.
96.tip: Save some whole corn kernels before blending the soup. They add texture and make it look freshly made, not like a boxed soup.

pasos: Freeze the mozzarella sticks at least 1 hour before breading.
Coat each stick in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs mixed with oregano.
Repeat the egg and breadcrumb step a second time, for a thicker coating.
Freeze again for 20 minutes before frying.
Fry in very hot oil 1-2 minutes per side, until golden.
Serve right away with hot marinara sauce.
97.tip: Freeze the cheese before frying, no exceptions. If it's not properly cold, it melts and escapes through the coating before it browns.

pasos: Slice the mango thinly and the banana into rounds.
Wash and halve the strawberries.
Serve the yogurt as a base, in a bowl or half coconut shell.
Arrange the fruit on top in sections, by color.
Sprinkle granola and garnish with fresh mint leaves.
Squeeze a little lemon juice over the banana so it doesn't brown.
98.tip: Cut the fruit right before serving, never hours ahead. Mango and banana lose texture and color very fast once cut.

pasos: Mix the apples with the sugar, cinnamon, flour and lemon juice.
Let sit 15 minutes so they release a bit of juice.
Roll out the first pastry and line a pie dish.
Fill with the apples, dotting butter pieces on top.
Cover with the second pastry, seal the edges and cut slits for steam to escape.
Brush with beaten egg and bake at 190 °C / 375 °F for 45-50 minutes, until golden.
99.tip: Let the apples rest with the sugar for 15 minutes before filling. Used straight off the cutting board, they release too much water during baking and leave the base soggy.

ingredientes: 2 packs frozen dragon fruit pulp (200 g)
pasos: Let the dragon fruit pulp sit 2 minutes at room temperature so you can break it into pieces.
Blend the dragon fruit, frozen banana and coconut milk with very little liquid, until thick.
If the blender stalls, push the mix down with a spatula instead of adding more liquid.
Serve in a chilled bowl.
Top in sections with strawberry, banana, granola and shredded coconut.
100.tip: Use very little coconut milk, almost none. Frozen dragon fruit already holds plenty of water, and too much liquid turns the bowl into juice instead of something that holds the toppings up.
